title: Glacials' Mining Dimension
description: A mod which adds a gigantic cave dimension perfectly suited for mining.
body:
This mod adds a new dimension, which is perfectly suited for minning, since it is a gigantic cave, but be carefull where you going the ghosts of past miners still haunt this place

To enter this dimension you will first have to craft the Gates to the Mines and the Interdimensional Pickaxe. Then by combining you will create the mining dimension an be able to access all of its riches
